title: DPIIT Data: Singapore Top Source of FDI Equity Inflows in FY26 ($17.6 Billion)
summary: India received $47.87B total FDI (foreign direct investment with management stake) equity inflows in Apr-Dec FY26; Singapore accounts for 37% share followed by US (16%) and Mauritius (10%).

blocks.title: 📰 2. 🏛️ REGULATORY BODIES NEWS
blocks.text: 🪝 DPIIT Data: Singapore Top Source of FDI Equity Inflows in FY26 ($17.6 Billion). Key development for Banking & General Awareness.

items: DPIIT released FDI (foreign direct investment with management stake) statistics for April-December FY26 showing **Singapore maintained its position as the top source of FDI (foreign direct investment with management stake) equity inflows to India** at $17.6 billion (37% of total).
**Top Sectors**: Computer Software & Hardware (22%, $10.7B) and Services Sector (18%).
**Top Recipient States**: Maharashtra ($15.38B) followed by Karnataka ($11.15B).
